FN-11Y4I33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 38
Committee: Ports, Waterways and Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/08/2026
House Bill 38 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Dauphin Island Sea Lab by an
undetermined amount to provide administrative support to the Alabama Seagrass Restoration
Task Force created by this bill. These obligations may be offset in part or in whole by the
retention of funds appropriated for administrative costs expended by the sea lab pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
Page 1
